## Load libraries

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lemon)
library(cowplot)
```

## House-style constants

```{r house-style}
# PNAS final-size artwork: Figure 4 is exported directly at one-column width.
FONT_FAMILY    <- "Helvetica"
FONT_SIZE_PT   <- 7
FONT_SIZE_GEOM <- FONT_SIZE_PT / .pt
GG_LINE_UNIT_PT  <- 0.75 * 72.27 / 25.4
pt_to_ggline     <- function(x) x / GG_LINE_UNIT_PT
SECONDARY_LINE_PT <- 0.25
AXIS_LINE_PT      <- 0.50
PRIMARY_LINE_PT   <- 0.75
LINE_SIZE      <- pt_to_ggline(AXIS_LINE_PT)
AXIS_LINE_SIZE <- pt_to_ggline(AXIS_LINE_PT)
TICK_LENGTH_PT <- 2.5
POINT_SIZE     <- 1.7
POINT_STROKE   <- 0.53
DODGE_WIDTH    <- 0.32
FIG_WIDTH      <- 3.42
FIG_HEIGHT     <- 2.671875

Y_LIMITS <- c(4.5, 6.0)
Y_BREAKS <- seq(4.5, 6.0, 0.5)

MODEL_X <- c(
  "GPT-4o" = 1.10,
  "OpenAI o1" = 1.85,
  "Grok 3" = 2.70,
  "Gemini 2.0 Flash" = 3.45
)
X_LIMITS <- c(0.55, 4.00)

GROUP_HEADER_Y   <- 0.965
LEGEND_POSITION  <- c(0.06, 0.14)
TOP_PAIR_X       <- c(0.2541, 0.4414)
BOTTOM_PAIR_X    <- c(0.6537, 0.8410)
BOTTOM_LABEL_X   <- mean(BOTTOM_PAIR_X)

theme_figure4 <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_family = FONT_FAMILY, base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(TICK_LENGTH_PT, "pt"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 3.5)),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.position = "inside",
      legend.position.inside = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.justification = c("left", "bottom"),
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(6, "pt"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(7, "pt"),
      legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = margin(16, 5, 5, 5)
    )
}
```

## Import data

```{r import-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- read_excel("data/Study_1_Subjective_Data.xlsx")
```

## Data processing and summary statistics

```{r data-processing-and-summary-statistics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Mean_Quality = (
      Statistical_Accuracy + Clarity_and_Structure +
        Conceptual_Depth + Pedagogical_Effectiveness
    ) / 4,
    Model_Name = case_when(
      Model == "ChatGPT_4o" ~ "GPT-4o",
      Model == "ChatGPT_o1" ~ "OpenAI o1",
      Model == "Grok3" ~ "Grok 3",
      Model == "Gemini_2.0" ~ "Gemini 2.0 Flash"
    )
  )

summary_data <- df %>%
  group_by(Model_Name, Profession) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Mean_Quality),
    sd = sd(Mean_Quality),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci_lower = mean - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = mean + 1.96 * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Model_Name = factor(
      Model_Name,
      levels = c("GPT-4o", "OpenAI o1", "Grok 3", "Gemini 2.0 Flash")
    ),
    Model_X = unname(MODEL_X[as.character(Model_Name)]),
    Profession = factor(Profession, levels = c("Instructor", "Student"))
  )
```

## Explicit visual mappings

```{r visual-mappings}
profession_colors <- c(
  "Instructor" = "#D55E00",
  "Student" = "#0072B2"
)

profession_shapes <- c(
  "Instructor" = 15,
  "Student" = 21
)
```

## Plot and export

```{r plot-and-export, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = DODGE_WIDTH)

p_base <- ggplot(
  summary_data,
  aes(x = Model_X, y = mean, colour = Profession, shape = Profession)
) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
    linewidth = LINE_SIZE,
    position = dodge,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE,
    fill = "white",
    position = dodge
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = profession_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = profession_shapes, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = X_LIMITS,
    breaks = unname(MODEL_X),
    labels = names(MODEL_X),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = Y_BREAKS,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = MODEL_X[["GPT-4o"]], xend = MODEL_X[["OpenAI o1"]],
    y = Y_LIMITS[1], yend = Y_LIMITS[1],
    colour = "black", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = MODEL_X[["Grok 3"]], xend = MODEL_X[["Gemini 2.0 Flash"]],
    y = Y_LIMITS[1], yend = Y_LIMITS[1],
    colour = "black", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  coord_capped_cart(
    ylim = Y_LIMITS,
    left = "both",
    gap = 0.01
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean guidance quality rating") +
  theme_figure4()

top_pair_center <- mean(TOP_PAIR_X)

p <- ggdraw(p_base) +
  draw_label(
    "Top two models",
    x = top_pair_center, y = GROUP_HEADER_Y,
    fontfamily = FONT_FAMILY, fontface = "bold",
    size = FONT_SIZE_PT, colour = "black"
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "Bottom two models",
    x = BOTTOM_LABEL_X, y = GROUP_HEADER_Y,
    fontfamily = FONT_FAMILY, fontface = "bold",
    size = FONT_SIZE_PT, colour = "black"
  )

p

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study1_2.pdf",
  p,
  width = FIG_WIDTH,
  height = FIG_HEIGHT,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  family = FONT_FAMILY,
  symbolfamily = FONT_FAMILY,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study1_2.png",
  p,
  width = FIG_WIDTH,
  height = FIG_HEIGHT,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study1_2.svg",
  p,
  width = FIG_WIDTH,
  height = FIG_HEIGHT,
  bg = "white"
)
```
